messages:
pagerbot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty incident triggered for service=inference-gateway (alert: high_5xx_rate). Current 5xx rate: 12.6% over 3m window. Pager: P0

sre_oncall_maya: acked via PagerDuty. I'm on it. Can someone post quick impact?

engineer_lee: seeing a big spike in 502/503 from the upstream model pool. Logs show a lot of KV cache miss errors and timeouts to redis-cluster.

ops_shift_lead_jess: customer visible errors on hosted API - slow 95th latency and increased error rate. CS already flagged two paying customers.

infra_bot: autoscaler: scaling event suppressed due to cooldown (last_scale 45s ago).

sre_oncall_maya: ok. First triage: 1) Are redis nodes OK? 2) Any recent deploys to inference runtime? 3) Fallback routing enabled?

engineer_lee: checking redis now. Running: `redis-cli -h redis-prod-01 INFO` shows high avg_latency_us: 1500 and blocked_clients=12. Also network retries to redis-prod-02 in logs. No recent runtime deploys in last 2h (checked deploybot).

ops_shift_lead_jess: routing: we have a fallback model variant (small-quant) in eu-west that can accept traffic. We could toggle routing to reduce load on main pool.

sre_oncall_maya: good. Plan: 1) temporary route 30% traffic to fallback variant via routing config 2) warm new redis replica / failover 3) monitor error rate and latency. I'll apply the route change now.

engineer_lee: taking redis replica out of maintenance and promoting read-replica -> primary candidate. Running promote script: `./infra/promote-redis --host redis-prod-03 --confirm`

infra_bot: command executed: promote-redis redis-prod-03 (request id x7c9). Promotion started. Estimated time ~45s.

sre_oncall_maya: routing change: `POST /v1/routing -d '{"service":"inference-gateway","split":{"main":0.7,"fallback-small":0.3}}'` -> applied.

ops_shift_lead_jess: :thumbsup: traffic split applied. Starting to see small drop in errors (5xx -> 9% within 30s) but still high.

engineer_lee: redis promote finished. New primary healthy. Running smoke: `curl -s -I https://inference.internal/health | head -n1` -> HTTP/1.1 200 OK on a couple hosts.

sre_oncall_maya: monitoring dashboards... 5xx trending down to 4.2% now. Latency p95 also improving.

pagerbot: PagerDuty: incident acknowledged by sre_oncall_maya. Next escalation: ops_shift_lead_jess in 10m if unack.

ops_shift_lead_jess: CS update: emailed impacted customers with ETA ~15m, asked to contact support if major issues.

engineer_lee: root cause hypothesis: transient network flakiness between inference nodes and redis-prod-02 caused KV cache misses, amplifying load on origin model instances. Autoscaler suppressed scale due to cooldown which made it worse. Will add a quick mitigation: reduce cooldown to allow faster reactive scaling for this service.

sre_oncall_maya: agree. Can we change autoscaler cooldown to 20s for inference-gateway temporary?

infra_bot: patch applied: autoscaler.cooldown_ms for inference-gateway set to 20000 (changed from 60000).

sre_oncall_maya: continuing to watch. 5xx ~1.1% and trending to baseline. Good sign. Leaving routing 70/30 for now for safety.

ops_shift_lead_jess: Jess -> taking notes for post-incident: customers impacted, routing change, redis failover, cooldown tweak. Will own the postmortem write-up.

engineer_lee: follow-up items (quick): 1) validate redis network path to redis-prod-02 and patch or replace NIC 2) consider KV cache warmup fallback when redis errors spike 3) add alert for autoscaler-suppressed-scaling events.

sre_oncall_maya: handoff: I'm going to sign out in 20m. Jess, please take the follow-up and handoff to next SRE rotation. If anything regresses, page immediately.

ops_shift_lead_jess: taking over. Thanks Maya. I'll update the incident record in PD and set follow-ups.

pagerbot: PagerDuty: escalation suppressed (incident on-call acked). Incident state: mitigated, monitoring.

sre_oncall_maya: quick note for post-incident: include the exact routing config change, promote logs, and customers emailed. Tagging `#postmortem` in the write-up.

ops_shift_lead_jess: copying runbook snippet for future faster mitigation:
```
# inference-gateway 5xx mitigation quick steps
1. Check autoscaler suppression: `GET /infra/autoscaler/status?service=inference-gateway`
2. If suppressed, consider `PATCH /infra/autoscaler -d '{"cooldown_ms":20000}'`
3. Route traffic: `POST /v1/routing -d '{"split":{...}}'`
4. Promote healthy redis replica: `./infra/promote-redis --host redis-prod-03 --confirm`
5. Notify CS and flip rollback if customer impact grows`
```

engineer_lee: adding note: add low-latency network test to daily infra checks to catch path regressions earlier.

sre_oncall_maya: last check before I sign out: dashboards stable, customer error reports decreased. Handing off fully to Jess. Thanks team. :rocket:

ops_shift_lead_jess: closing thread for now. Will follow up in PM with the postmortem link and runbook updates.

pagerbot: Incident closed by ops_shift_lead_jess after monitoring period.
